tags.title: Tags
tags.delete_body: It will be removed from everything that has it. The items themselves stay.
tags.pick_body: You'll see everything carrying it across contracts, files, music, work items and expenses, ready to download.
tags.date_help: Music uses the release date, expenses the expense date, contracts the start date and everything else the creation date.
tags.no_matches: Nothing matches this search or these dates.

combine.all_help: Items that carry all of these tags at once
combine.any_help: Items that carry at least one of these tags
combine.nothing_all: Nothing carries all of these tags at once.
combine.switch_any: Show items with any of them

ai.title: Map with AI
ai.description: AI reads contracts, files, work items and expenses (and, if you choose, songs and releases) and proposes whose each thing is, what it is and which of your tags it belongs to. You review before applying.
ai.music_note: Songs and releases are optional: they already reach their artist's tag through credits. Include them to also file them under projects, campaigns or catalogs. A large catalog takes longer.
ai.how: Several agents review each kind at the same time. They propose artist and type tags (cover art, publishing contract, invoice…), add things to tags you already have (projects, campaigns, catalogs) when they clearly belong, and spot names spelled several ways. Nothing is applied without your review, and every applied mapping can be undone.
ai.can_close: You can close this panel: the mapping keeps going and the result will be here to review.
ai.nothing: The AI found nothing new to propose.
ai.merges_help: Tags that look like the same artist spelled several ways. Unifying them puts everything under one name.
ai.auto_review: Proposals for the {count} files uploaded recently. Review and apply what is right.
ai.skipped: Not reviewed: {names}. The music catalog needs its module on and a workspace admin.
ai.dropped: The proposal was very large: {count} lower-confidence suggestions were left out.
ai.unanswered: The AI couldn't answer for {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}, even in smaller batches: they were left unreviewed. Start another mapping to try again.
ai.failed_kinds: These couldn't be reviewed: {names}. The rest of the mapping finished; start it again to retry.

peek.link_copied: Link copied: anyone in the workspace opens it here
peek.not_available: Not found, or you don't have access
